name: Suicidal Reaction Tendency (SR-45)
description: Assesses a tendency towards suicidal reactions, making it possible to identify people at risk. Developed by P. I. Yunatskevich.
instruction: Please answer 45 statements. Choose "Yes" if you agree and "No" if you don't. Try not to think too long about your answers; there are no right or wrong answers.

1.text: Do you think life can lose its value for a person in some situations?

2.text: Life is sometimes worse than death

3.text: In the past I have tried to end my life

4.text: Many people love, understand and value me

5.text: Terminally ill people who choose to die can be justified

6.text: I don't think I could ever end up in a hopeless situation

7.text: The meaning of life is not always clear; it can be lost or never found

8.text: If your family and loved ones betrayed you, do you think you could go on living?

9.text: I sometimes think about taking my own life

10.text: In any situation I will fight for my life, whatever it costs

11.text: I always try to be completely honest everywhere

13.text: Perhaps I won't be able to go on living

14.text: It is surprising that some people in a hopeless situation don't want to kill themselves

15.text: A feeling of doom eventually leads to taking one's own life

16.text: If necessary, taking one's own life can be justified

17.text: I don't like playing with death on my own

18.text: The first impression of a person is often the decisive one

19.text: I have tried different ways of ending my life

20.text: At a critical moment I can always pull myself together

21.text: At school I was always well-behaved

22.text: I can deceive the people around me to make my situation worse

23.text: There are quite a lot of dishonest people around me

24.text: Once I considered several ways of killing myself

25.text: People quite often try to deceive or mislead me

26.text: I would not want to die instantly after going through something painful

27.text: I would go on living if a global nuclear war broke out

28.text: A person is free to do what they want with their life, even if they choose death

29.text: A person who can't present themselves well to management loses out on a lot

30.text: I have never written a suicide note to anyone

31.text: Once I tried to kill myself

32.text: There is no such thing as a situation with no way out

33.text: I have tried to kill myself in a way that would not cause much pain

34.text: You need to be able to hide your thoughts from others, even if they don't care about me

35.text: A person's soul probably feels relief when it leaves this world by its own choice

36.text: I can justify anything I do

37.text: If I am doing something and people start getting in my way, I will still do what I planned

38.text: To escape an incurable illness and stop suffering, a person should probably end their suffering and leave this life voluntarily

39.text: I sometimes doubt the mental health of some people I know

40.text: Once I made up my mind to kill myself

41.text: The absence of happiness in my life worries me

42.text: I never break the law, even in small things

43.text: Sometimes I want to fall asleep and never wake up

44.text: Most of the time you feel generally weak.

summaries.Суицидальная реакция может возникнуть то: A suicidal reaction can only arise after prolonged psychological trauma or in reactive mental states.
summaries.«Потенциал» склонности к суицидальным ре: The 'potential' for suicidal reactions is not very stable
summaries.Группа суицидального риска с высоким уро: Suicide risk group with a high tendency towards suicidal reactions (if adjustment breaks down, a suicide attempt or self-destructive behaviour is possible).
summaries.Группа суицидального риска с очень высок: Suicide risk group with a very high tendency towards suicidal reactions (internal and external conflict; needs medical and psychological help).
summaries.Показатели по шкале лжи в норме: Lie scale within the normal range
summaries.Показатели по шкале лжи выше нормы: Lie scale above the normal range
